title: narcissus conspicuus
intro: Narcissus conspicuus, commonly known as the Tazetta daffodil, is a species of flowering bulbous perennial plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. It is rich in bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The health benefits of Narcissus conspicuus include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve immune function.
